preamble: Note: The fish, crustaceans, molluscs, and other aquatic invertebrates shall be deemed originating even if they were cultivated from nonoriginating fry (immature fish at a post-larval stage, including fingerlings, parr, smolts, and elvers) or larvae.

rules.text: A change to headings 0301 through 0305 from any other chapter.

(A) A change to smoked goods of headings 0306 through 0308 from goods that are not smoked of headings 0306 through 0308; or
(B) A change to any other good of headings 0306 through 0308 from any other chapter.
